questions.stem: A plugin loader creates an instance of every type it finds by calling getDeclaredConstructors()[0], then setAccessible(true), then newInstance(...) with suitable arguments. It finds `final class Metrics { static final Metrics INSTANCE = new Metrics(); private Metrics() {} }` and `enum AuditLog { INSTANCE }`. What do the two calls produce?

options.text: A second Metrics, and an exception for AuditLog, since setAccessible opens the private constructor and newInstance refuses enum classes
options.says: a private constructor only stops source code from calling it; Constructor.newInstance throws IllegalArgumentException for any enum

options.text: A second Metrics, and a second AuditLog, since setAccessible opens the private constructor and newInstance treats an enum like any class
options.says: Constructor.newInstance refuses enum classes with IllegalArgumentException: Cannot reflectively create enum objects

options.text: An exception for both, since setAccessible can't open a private constructor and newInstance refuses enum classes
options.says: setAccessible(true) opens the class's private constructor, and the run builds a second instance

options.text: An exception for Metrics, and a second AuditLog, since setAccessible can't open a private constructor and newInstance treats an enum like any class
options.says: setAccessible opens the class's private constructor, and newInstance refuses enum classes with IllegalArgumentException

questions.stem: A coordinator JVM has taken 1,000 ids from `enum Ids { INSTANCE; private final AtomicLong next = new AtomicLong(); long nextId() { return next.incrementAndGet(); } }`. It writes Ids.INSTANCE to an ObjectOutputStream, and a freshly started worker JVM reads it with an ObjectInputStream and calls nextId() on the result. What does the worker get?

options.text: 1001, since the constant's fields are written to the stream and the worker's constant takes them over
options.says: an enum constant is written as its name only; its fields are not in the stream

options.text: 1001, since the stream carries a copy of the coordinator's constant along with its counter
options.says: the reader gets the constant that already exists in its own JVM, not a copy

options.text: 1, since only the constant's name is written and the worker looks up its own constant
options.says: the stream holds the name; the worker resolves it to its own INSTANCE, whose counter has not moved

options.text: 1, since reading the stream builds a new constant whose counter starts again from zero
options.says: deserialization returns the existing constant (deserialized == INSTANCE is true), not a new one

origin.section: An Enum With One Constant Is a Singleton That Reflection and Serialization Can't Copy

questions.stem: A publishing workflow declares `enum Phase { DRAFT(Set.of(Phase.REVIEW)), REVIEW(Set.of(Phase.LIVE)), LIVE(Set.of()); final Set<Phase> next; Phase(Set<Phase> next) { this.next = next; } }` and builds it with javac 21. What happens?

options.text: javac rejects it, since a constant's arguments may not name a constant declared after it, qualified or not
options.says: javac 21 reports illegal forward reference for the qualified form too

options.text: javac rejects it, since an enum constructor may not take a collection of its own enum type
options.says: a constructor taking a set of its own enum type is what the page's state example declares; javac's only errors there are forward references

options.text: It compiles, and loading Phase fails at run time, since REVIEW is still null when DRAFT is built
options.says: javac 21 refuses the qualified forward reference, so there is no class to load

options.text: It compiles and works, since the qualified name Phase.REVIEW is looked up once every constant exists
options.says: constants are built in declaration order, and javac refuses the reference before anything runs

origin.section: A State Machine Keeps Its Transitions in an EnumMap Filled After the Constants Exist

questions.stem: `enum Feature { EXPORT, API, SSO; static final Set<Feature> BASIC = EnumSet.of(EXPORT); }`. A signup handler runs `Set<Feature> f = Feature.BASIC; if (trial) f.add(Feature.API); save(user, f);`. A trial user signs up, and then a regular user. What is saved for the regular user?

options.text: EXPORT and API, since f is the shared set itself and the trial's add changed it for every later signup
options.says: final fixes the reference, not the set; the add went into BASIC

options.text: EXPORT and API, since EnumSet.of hands every caller one cached set per enum type and the trial's add went into it
options.says: the sharing is the field: the EnumSet.of call in its initializer ran once, and every user of BASIC holds that one set

options.text: EXPORT only, since final on BASIC keeps its contents from changing after the class is loaded
options.says: final fixes the reference only; the set stays mutable

options.text: EXPORT only, since the trial's add threw, because a set made by EnumSet.of refuses any change
options.says: a set from EnumSet.of is mutable; only a wrapper such as Collections.unmodifiableSet throws on add

origin.section: EnumSet Is a Typed Bit Mask, and a Shared One Must Be Unmodifiable
